rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something having high value or worth.

example.english: This document is precious, so please don't lose it.
example.traditional: 呢份文件好寶貴，千祈唔好整唔見。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 man4 gin6 hou2 bou2 gwai3 cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 zing2 m4 gin3

rows.note: Use this when “precious” means endearingly cute or beloved rather than materially valuable.

example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 maau1 zai2 zan1 hai6 ho2 oi3

rows.note: Use this with an object such as a person’s work when someone is unusually protective or touchy about it.

example.english: They’re precious about their painting and won’t let anyone touch it.
example.traditional: 佢對自己幅畫好緊張，唔畀人掂。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 zi6 gei2 fuk1 waa2 hou2 gan2 zoeng1 m4 bei2 jan4 dim3

rows.note: Use this when something is fussy or unnecessarily elaborate in its design or presentation.

example.english: This packaging is too precious and looks fussy.
example.traditional: 呢個包裝太花巧，睇落好煩。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 baau1 zong1 taai3 faa1 haau2 tai2 lok6 hou2 faan4
